6. Intimation of Government dues to Accounts Officer.The Head of Office after ascertaining and assessing the Government dues, shall furnish the particulars thereof to the Accounts Officer promptly.  
- Rules 60, 61 and 67.  
7. Processing of Pension cases mandatorily through Bhavishya.All Heads of Offices will mandatorily process all pension cases only through Bhavishya unless otherwise exempted. - Rule 53.
